scope: Project-authored development diagnostics. These cases were used to identify model weaknesses and guide the scenario supplement; scores are not independent validation. Public-data test examples remain separate.

intent.text: Please stop the purchase I made this morning before the warehouse sends it out.

intent.label: change_order

intent.text: Will you deduct a charge if I cancel before my parcel leaves the warehouse?

intent.text: How do I buy a product from your website and complete checkout?

intent.text: I cannot remember my login password. How can I get access again?

intent.text: The product was excellent and I would like to leave a review on its page.
intent.label: review
